topic: how does the TCP handshake work
narration: Your laptop sends a sync message. It says, let's talk, my counter starts at one hundred. The server replies with sync ack. It says, got it, my counter starts at three hundred, I confirm your one hundred. Finally your laptop sends ack. It says, confirmed your three hundred. Now both sides know the other's starting number. So every later byte can be numbered and tracked. If one goes missing, they know exactly which one.
